description: This file defines the 'Mean' class which computes the arithmetic mean of a set of values, either incrementally or from an array. It includes handling for weighted and unweighted means, as well as methods for copying and evaluating subsets of data.

classes.name: Mean
classes.description: A class that calculates the arithmetic mean of a dataset, supporting incremental updates, array evaluations, and weighted means.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Incrementally adds a new value to the dataset, updating the internal state.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the statistic, clearing all stored data.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Computes the mean of a specified subarray of values or the entire array, with support for weighted data.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of this Mean instance, including its internal state.
